dedupe_keys.name: 台灣電力公司基隆市再生能源可併網容量 electricity and power series on taiwan government open data platform

description: 台灣電力公司基隆市再生能源可併網容量 [electricity and power] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣電力股份有限公司. 提供基隆市的饋線可併網容量、變壓器的TWD67X、Y座標値及所屬饋線資訊。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 15 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣電力股份有限公司. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2024-07-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
